review_notes: I read the whole file. The new definitions are tateRes, kerNormTransfer and trivialTateRes. Each is built from the project's own TauCeti.TateCohomology.H0Res, HNegOneRes, negSuccRes and relTransferKerNorm, and from Mathlib's groupCohomology.map. Mathlib has only TateCohomology/Basic.lean. My searches of Mathlib/RepresentationTheory for relTransfer, HNegOneRes, H0Res and transfer found nothing. So Mathlib has no existing Tate restriction or transfer for these definitions to compete with. tateRes is a layer-specific specialisation of the generic TateCohomology.res, and tateRes_eq_res links the two explicitly. The same holds for trivialTateRes. Keeping them as named layer-specific APIs looks intentional. I found no justified duplicate of a Mathlib concept.
